title: Halting during rewind
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $x$ be an input, and let $r,T$ be natural numbers. Suppose every choice word of length exactly $T$, run on $N$ from its initial configuration on $x$, ends in a halted configuration. For every $i\in\mathbb N$ and $j$ with $0\le j\le r$ such that $j+i=r$, every counter $c$ with $0\le c\le r+1$, and every augmented configuration $C$ in rewind phase at $(j,c)$ with empty output and all later blocks blank with their heads at $0$, every choice word of length exactly $i(T+|x|+2)+1$ causes the amplified machine started from $C$ to halt.
